rules.title: Email Gateway .ics Attachment from Newly-Registered Domain Detection
rules.content:
index=email sourcetype=email_gateway
| where attachment_type="text/calendar" OR attachment_extension=".ics"
| lookup domain_age_feed sender_domain OUTPUT domain_age_days
| where domain_age_days < 30
| stats count by sender_domain, recipient, subject, domain_age_days
| where count > 5
| sort -count

rules.title: Calendar Event Injection from Newly-Registered High-Abuse TLD Domains
rules.content:
SELECT ce.event_id, ce.organizer_email, ce.title, ce.created_at,
       d.domain_name, d.registration_date, d.tld
FROM calendar_events ce
JOIN domain_intel d ON ce.organizer_domain = d.domain_name
WHERE ce.organizer_is_external = TRUE
AND ce.auto_accepted = TRUE
AND d.registration_date > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'
AND d.tld IN ('.cyou', '.sbs', '.click', '.biz', '.top', '.xyz')
ORDER BY ce.created_at DESC;

rules.title: RDGA Sender Domain Consonant Ratio Detection for Calendar Phishing
rules.content:
SELECT domain_label,
       LENGTH(REGEXP_REPLACE(domain_label, '[aeiou]', '', 'gi'))::FLOAT /
       NULLIF(LENGTH(domain_label), 0) AS consonant_ratio,
       tld, registration_date
FROM zone_file_domains
WHERE registration_date > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days'
AND tld IN ('.cyou', '.sbs', '.click')
AND LENGTH(REGEXP_REPLACE(domain_label, '[aeiou]', '', 'gi'))::FLOAT /
    NULLIF(LENGTH(domain_label), 0) > 0.75
ORDER BY registration_date DESC;

rules.title: Calendar Invite Injection from Suspicious External Organizer
rules.content:
title: Calendar Invite Injection from Suspicious External Organizer
id: f8a2c4e1-9b3d-4f7a-8e6c-1d2a3b4c5d6e
status: experimental
description: Detects calendar events auto-accepted from external organizers on newly-registered or high-abuse TLD domains, indicating potential calendar phishing injection.
references:
  - https://github.com/FraudLens/flame
threat_paths:
  - TP-0050
cfpf_phase: P2
fraud_types:
  - calendar-phishing
logsource:
    product: google-workspace
    service: calendar
detection:
    selection_external:
        organizer.is_external: true
        event.auto_accepted: true
    selection_tld:
        organizer.domain|endswith:
            - '.cyou'
            - '.sbs'
            - '.click'
            - '.biz'
            - '.top'
            - '.xyz'
    condition: selection_external AND selection_tld
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate calendar invitations from organizations using newer TLDs
  - Automated scheduling services using recently registered domains
level: high
tags:
  - attack.t1566.003
  - cfpf.phase2.calendar_injection
  - flame.calendar_phishing
